method.render: Existing Poppler 115 dpi page PNGs were actually viewed; no re-render by reviewer.
method.scope: Pages 1-20 reviewed on contact sheets; pages 21-26 reviewed both in context and at full page resolution. This is a layout review, not a substitute for theorem verification.

observations: Consistent margins, readable headings and theorem/Lean annotation styling.
No clipped or overlapping prose, formulas or annotations observed.
Displayed adaptive bound, rate and shear-recovery formulas are legible.
Section transitions and page numbers are correctly positioned; no missing glyphs or unresolved cross-references observed.
